text.p: Konka Group Co Ltd, one of China's top colour television makers, said on Friday it will issue a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.52 yuan per share based on 1996 profits.
The registration deadline is July 11 and the firm's A and B shares listed in Shenzhen will go ex-dividend on July 14, Konka said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company said it would pay the dividend to B shareholders in Hong Kong dollars at an exchange rate of HK$1 to 1.0713 yuan.
Konka, based in the southern Chinese boomtown of Shenzhen, posted a net profit of 346 million yuan for 1996, up 29 percent against 268 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
